no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Synlogic is a non-operating public shell company. In February 2024 it discontinued Synpheny-3, its pivotal Phase 3 study of labafenogene marselecobac (SYNB1934) for PKU, after an internal review indicated the trial was unlikely to meet its primary endpoint (no safety/tolerability concerns). Per the 10-K filed 2026-03-12, as of March 5, 2026 the company has one full-time employee, no ongoing R&D activities, and no active clinical trial; R&D expense for the nine months ended 2025 was only $16,000. Nasdaq delisted SYBX on January 21, 2026; shares now trade on OTC. The board is pursuing strategic alternatives including merger or sale.
